title: NEW: Posy the Little Unicorn's Rainbow Birthday

scenes.small: a story kids color AND read
scenes.say: Does your little girl love unicorns? Meet Posy, the little unicorn!
It's Posy's birthday, but oh no! The rainbow has no colors.
Bibi the butterfly has a magic paintbrush.
Together they paint the rainbow. Swish, swish, swish!
Happy birthday, Posy! Make a wish!
Your little one colors every page, and brings the rainbow back. Ages three to six. Link in bio!
